biotools.summary: Utilvo is a privacy-preserving client-side information processing framework and browser-based scientific data analysis suite developed by Islam Ayoub (ORCID: 0009-0002-1503-5639). Executed entirely within the browser sandbox using WebAssembly (Wasm), Web Workers, and the Web Cryptography API (AES-GCM-256, SHA-256), Utilvo enables zero-trust local analysis of sensitive biomedical, genomic, clinical, and structured research documents (JSON, CSV, XML, PDF, and scientific imaging) without transmitting raw files to external servers.
